support.title: It has been heavy for a while
support.body: You have had several hard days this past week. Struggling is common in a busy time with a baby, and you do not have to carry it alone. Talking to someone often helps.
support.helsestasjon: Talk to your health clinic (helsestasjon) or your GP. They have time to listen, to you as well.
support.mentalHelp: Mental Helse helpline: <helpline>116 123</helpline> (open around the clock)
support.urgent: If you need help quickly, call the out-of-hours doctor (legevakt) on <legevakt>116 117</legevakt>. If a life is in danger, call <emergency>113</emergency>.
